title.zh: 币安宣布将于2026年11月10日停止Binance Pool及相关服务
title.en: Binance to Discontinue Binance Pool and Related Services on November 10, 2026

current_state.zh: Binance announced it will discontinue Binance Pool and all related services on November 10, 2026, terminating mining-pool connections and Stratum addresses, requiring miners to migrate to other pools and settle Pool Savings positions, with historical data pages closing November 24, 2026.
current_state.en: Binance announced it will discontinue Binance Pool and all related services on November 10, 2026, terminating mining-pool connections and Stratum addresses, requiring miners to migrate to other pools and settle Pool Savings positions, with historical data pages closing November 24, 2026.
